note: Fail-closed per-gate cardinality contracts for packs/ash-pplan-chaos-pack.
Keyed by GATE STEM (gates/NNN_stem.rq -> "stem"), not filename.
Every contract is PREDICATE-anchored: the anchor's own blind spot (total loss of the
anchor predicate) is exactly what the companion verify/*.unbound.rq queries name, so
contract + companion have disjoint blind spots.
"invariants" is anchored on acp:order, NOT acp:seed: acp:seed is shared with
acp:KillPhase individuals in this ontology (6 Invariants + 4 KillPhases carry acp:seed),
so a seed anchor would over-count. acp:order is carried by Invariants only. The anchor's
blind spot (total loss of acp:order) is named by the companion
"harness" is anchored on acp:testNamespace, carried by Harness rows only.
